messages:
Talia Benson: heads up — I’m blocked in AWS Marketplace Mgmt Portal. getting “You do not have sufficient permissions to perform this action” when I try to edit listing fields + upload docs. anyone know who actually has submit rights?

Connor O'Brien: are you going through the vendor account (Seller portal) or AWS Partner Central?

Talia Benson: AWS Marketplace Management Portal (the one w/ "Manage products"), via SSO. I can view products but “Edit” + “Submit for review” are disabled.

Soojin Lee: +1, I can’t access either. I got a different error: “MFA required for role assumption” and then it loops.

Camila Reyes: we need to sort this asap — AWS asked for updated screenshots + security packet by end of week.

PartnerOps Bot: If you need access to AWS/GCP marketplace vendor portals, file an internal request: INT-332 (Vendor portal access). Include portal type (AWS/GCP), requested role, and business justification.

Connor O'Brien: there’s a Confluence process doc for this. I think only a small set of “submitters” can push listing changes (audit reasons). Let me find link.

Connor O'Brien: found it: sources/confluence/policies-and-process/vendor-management/aws-gcp-marketplace-vendor-account-access-and-rotation.json ("AWS/GCP marketplace vendor account access and rotation"). TL;DR: least-privilege, no shared creds, and only approved submitters can hit “Submit for review.”

Talia Benson: ok makes sense. but who are the approved submitters right now? I don’t want to spam INT-332 if it’s just a group membership.

Olga Petrov: per the vendor mgmt process, submit rights are restricted to Partnerships owner + delegate submitters; everyone else should be “viewer” unless there’s a documented need. It’s tied to SOX-ish controls + keeping a clean audit trail.

Marcus Lin: also important: the doc requires hardware MFA for privileged roles. if you’re getting the MFA loop, it may be because your account is trying to assume a role that now enforces FIDO2 keys (no SMS). We tightened that last quarter.

Soojin Lee: I have Okta Verify but not a hardware key. Is that why?

Marcus Lin: likely. For AWS vendor portal role assumption we require either FIDO2 key or the specific Okta FastPass policy (depends on group). The loop usually happens when the policy is “required” but the auth method isn’t enrolled.

Dev Patel: if you want, drop the exact error text + screenshot (redact account IDs). support’s seen the “insufficient permissions” thing when people are in the generic Partner Central group but not the Marketplace Management Portal group.

Talia Benson: error banner: “Your account is not authorized to access this application. Please contact your administrator.” (then after retry: “You do not have sufficient permissions to perform this action.”)

Connor O'Brien: that sounds like you’re in the app but not in the right AWS IAM role. The doc says we use named roles like `AWSMarketplaceSubmitter` vs `AWSMarketplaceViewer` (don’t quote me on exact name).

Camila Reyes: who can submit today? We need a confirmed owner so we don’t miss the deadline.

Olga Petrov: last I saw, only 2 people had submit privileges for AWS and 2 for GCP (plus break-glass). Names are tracked in the vendor mgmt doc appendix, but it’s not meant to be broad. If we need to add Soojin/Talia temporarily, it has to go through INT-332 + Security approval.

Michael Grant: looping in Legal perspective: we should avoid “too many cooks” in the vendor portals. AWS/GCP submissions can trigger terms/claims changes; we need a controlled set of submitters and a review checklist.

Talia Benson: got it. can we do a tactical approach: Connor submits the changes while Soojin + I prep copy/screenshots, and we request submit access only if needed?

Connor O'Brien: works for me. I can be the submitter for this round as long as I’m still in the group.

Soojin Lee: I’m fine not having submit, but I at least need edit access or a way to preview formatting. otherwise I’m blind on how the copy renders.

Connor O'Brien: we can screen-share during the edit session, or I can paste the “long description” preview in a doc. But edit access might still be restricted.

Marcus Lin: if we’re granting edit rights, make sure it’s time-boxed + tracked. The vendor mgmt doc calls out rotation + quarterly review of submitters.

Camila Reyes: action items:
1) Connor confirm he can submit in AWS portal today.
2) Talia file INT-332 for Soojin “viewer + preview” access (if that’s a thing) OR at minimum access to the portal for read-only.
3) Marcus/Olga: can you approve the request quickly if required?

Talia Benson: filing INT-332 now w/ justification: “Marketplace refresh project — need read-only access to validate listing copy rendering + required attachments.”

PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: INT-332 requests require approvers: Security (Dr. Aisha Rahman delegate) + GRC (Olga Petrov) + Requester’s manager.

Olga Petrov: I’ll watch for it and approve once it’s in. Please include whether this is AWS, GCP, or both.

Soojin Lee: adding: I also need GCP Marketplace access (at least to see the listing template fields). We’re seeing different formatting requirements.

Connor O'Brien: re AWS: I just logged in. I can access “Manage products” and the “Request changes” flow is available. I can upload docs.

Camila Reyes: perfect. let’s keep submissions through Connor for now. once INT-332 is approved, we’ll reassess.

Marcus Lin: please do NOT upload the SOC2 report itself unless the packet explicitly allows it (NDA gating). Use the evidence index + approved excerpts.

Talia Benson: noted. We’ll follow the security packet guidance + only attach what’s on the approved list.

Dev Patel: if anything breaks during submission (403s / portal timeouts), drop it here and I can help triage, but it usually ends up being IAM group membership.

Connor O'Brien: once Soojin finishes final copy blocks, send me the exact text + attachment filenames so I can make the portal edits without re-typing.

Soojin Lee: will do — I’ll send a single doc with copy + field mapping and a list of which screenshots go where.

Camila Reyes: thanks all. keep this thread updated once INT-332 is approved + if we hit any portal issues.
